english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a business or corporation.
Use this as the all-purpose word for a business or firm, including a partnership when its legal structure is not the focus.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a corporation or incorporated business.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a company or business.
Use 公司 for the company as the workplace or as the employer, especially in office-work contexts.
Use this when “outfit” means a business or firm rather than a group of people generally.
Use this only when concern means a business, firm, or company.
